_comment: Single source of truth for each class's pros, cons and special ability. Read by the game (class guidebook, class-pick chat message) and used to generate the Player Classes table in README.md: after editing, run ./gradlew generateClassReadme. A trailing ' (done)' is a dev status marker shown only in the README. specialOnKey says whether the special is fired with the Power Up key (otherwise it is always active).

classes.name: Barbarian
cons: Limited vision (fog closes in at ~24 blocks)
special: Rage: Strength I for 8s, up to Strength III for 12s with ranks, inspired by *One Punch Man*

classes.name: Bard
special: Nearby animals you have charmed with an instrument become companions that follow and fight for you

classes.name: Cleric
cons: Shorter viewing distance (fog closes in at ~48 blocks)
special: Circle of ignoring mobs for 6 to 15 seconds as it ranks up; from rank II party members within 8 to 16 blocks share it and get Regeneration

classes.name: Druid
pros: Gains an extra heart per tamed animal (up to 5)
cons: Gets hungry in the dark (light 4 or less)
special: Wild Shape: transforms into an animal it has killed and unlocked at an Attunement Table, for 15-30s by rank (sneak + key picks the form)

classes.name: Fighter
pros: Attracts mobs: hostile mobs prefer a Fighter over other players (done)
cons: No potions: can't use potion items and potion buffs don't apply, harmful potions still do (done)
special: Super regeneration: Regeneration V for 4s, up to 10s with ranks (done)

classes.name: Monk
cons: Reduced damage output (75% unarmored, less the more armor you wear)
Can only attack with a staff or bare fists

classes.name: Paladin
pros: Unaffected by potions, good or bad (ability effects still apply) (done)
cons: Cannot craft anything (crafting, stonecutter, smithing table, loom) or brew potions (done)
Very weak in the Nether: half damage and armor, 20% slower (done)
special: Divine Judgment: a beam of holy light strikes the mob you look at within 30 blocks and sets it alight, with a shockwave around it; undead take 50% more. Damage, shockwave and extra beams grow with its rank (done)

classes.name: Ranger
pros: Can zoom in with bow, faster firing (done)
special: Hold right click to spam fire (no ammo consumed) (done)

classes.name: Rogue
pros: No need to eat: food never drains and no starvation, but no natural regen from food either (done)

classes.name: Necromancer
special: Can spawn allied undead to attack enemies (done)

classes.name: Warlock
pros: Can throw fireballs with an empty hand (done)
cons: Hurt by water and rain, 1 damage every 4s but never below 1 heart (done)
special: Breathes fire on the special key, 8 s and 3 blocks at rank I up to 20 s and 7 blocks at rank IV (done)

classes.name: Wizard
cons: Can't wear armor heavier than iron (done)
special: Arcane explosion: 12-block blast and Resistance V for 2s, up to 72 blocks and 5s with ranks (done)

classes.name: Artificer
pros: 25% chance for crafted tools, weapons and armor to come out enchanted (done)
cons: Unaffected by potions except abilities: can't drink potions, immune to splash/lingering/tipped-arrow effects (done)
special: Temporarily buffs all armor: +8 armor, +4 toughness for 30 seconds (done)

classes.name: Blood Hunter
pros: Fire aspect applied to all swords (done)
cons: Can't drop swords: they still drop on death (done)
special: Blood Control: take control of the mob you look at, 8s within 15 blocks at 60% success, up to 20s, 30 blocks and 100% with ranks; strong mobs resist more, a failure costs the mana and a heart, bosses can't be controlled (needs the Identity mod) (done)

classes.name: Alchemist
pros: Can craft special potions exclusive to the class (done)
Brewing stands don't explode: a vanilla brewing stand explodes when its brew finishes if the last player to use it wasn't an Alchemist (stands nobody has used, e.g. hopper-fed, are safe) (done)
cons: Cannot enchant (enchanting table or enchanted books on an anvil) (done)
special: Transmute: throw your held potion (or an unstable brew) as a lingering cloud with stronger effects, buffs for allies and harmful effects for mobs; bigger and longer with ranks (done)
